sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown: `top-cd-stub`'s Title column gets two new sections, "Title info - Added" and "Title info - Modified" — one entry per distinct "N <unit> ago" age phrase, decomposed from the row's own `.comment` span ("Added N ago, last modified M ago") via a new `_findCellTitleAgeParts()` extractor. Deliberately not built on the generic `comment:`/`entityComment` machinery — a `/cdstub/<hash>` href is never recognized as an entity ref (`cdstub` is absent from `_ENTITY_TYPE_GLYPH`), and the two facets (Added vs. Modified) need independent tracking. A new `_highlightTitleAgeMatch()` uses lookbehind/lookahead anchoring so an identical Added/Modified phrase (e.g. both "9 years ago") highlights only the matching half.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Unique-values dropdown: "Catalog info - Prefix" (the "Catalog#" column) silently dropped the prefix for any real-world catalog number ending in embedded punctuation with no space (e.g. "SOPL-248"), separated by a bare hyphen/dot/slash instead of whitespace ("40-32210", "138.645", "746.225/2-032210"), or with no separator at all ("CDCBS65480") — `_findCellCatalogParts()`'s old `/^(?:(.+?)\s+)?(\d+)$/` grammar required the entire trailing portion to be pure digits with whitespace separation. Replaced with a first-digit-index split that recovers all of these shapes while reproducing identical output for every shape that already worked. A multi-word prefix (e.g. "CBS S") is now also split on internal whitespace into independent TOKENS — "CBS" and "S" each become their own separately filterable dropdown entry, since a short token like "S" recurs across unrelated labels and is independently meaningful; `_highlightCatalogPrefixMatch()` is now word-boundary-anchored so checking a short token never lights up a substring inside an unrelated prefix (e.g. "S" inside "CDCBS").

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Unique-values dropdown: every "Catalog info - Prefix" entry now carries a generic explanatory tooltip on hover, covering catalog-number anatomy (prefix/main number/suffix, non-standardized separators) and the historical — but explicitly non-universal — "S"/"M" stereo/mono letter convention. One static explanation for every entry; no per-prefix lookup table, since no reliable source maps specific letter codes to specific label meanings.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown: `artist-works`' "Attributes" column (MusicBrainz's own identifier-badge shape — ACAM ID, SUISA ID, BUMA/STEMRA ID, PRS tune code, …) gets a new "Attributes - Identifier type" section — one entry per identifier TYPE, via a new `_findCellWorkAttributeIdentifiers()` extractor. Deliberately a distinct label/glyph from the existing "Attributes" section (free-text recording-attribute words like "live"/"cover") and gated by DOM shape (`.work-attribute` badges), not column name, so the two families never collide even though both can appear under a column literally named "Attributes". Reads the live, already-`expandShowAllCells()`-expanded DOM, so a truncated cell's hidden identifiers (behind MusicBrainz's own "(show N more)" placeholder) are still fully counted.
